verdict.rationale: Twenty documents batch create/update/delete (up to 60 records) and GraphQL batch upsert, plus webhooks that fire on record create/update/delete for change detection, and unlimited API import for large-scale sync — covering upserts and change detection reasonably well. However, no documented API rate limits appear anywhere in the evidence pack, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: documented rate limits, explicit bidirectional sync guarantees/conflict handling, and independent evidence of sync working reliably at scale.
